---
title: "Profiles"
subtitle: "Where the interpreter spends its time"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
m <- REF_MACHINE
pr <- merge(D$profiles, D$runs[, c("run", "machine", "version", "kind", "config", "date")], by = "run")
pr <- pr[pr$kind == "release", ]
latest_run <- function(mm) {
  r <- D$runs[D$runs$machine == mm & D$runs$kind == "release" & D$runs$config == "default", ]
  r[which.max(r$date), ]
}
```

```{r}
suite_share <- function(mm) {
  d <- pr[pr$machine == mm, ]
  # mean over benchmarks of each benchmark's group share: every benchmark counts once
  g <- aggregate(share ~ run + benchmark + version + date + group, data = d, FUN = sum)
  g <- aggregate(share ~ version + date + group, data = g, FUN = mean)
  g <- g[order(g$date), ]
  g$version <- factor(g$version, levels = unique(g$version))
  plot_group_stack(g, "version", height = 340)
}
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", "Across releases, whole corpus"),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Mean over benchmarks, so long benchmarks do not dominate."),
  machine_tabs(D$machines$machine, suite_share)
)
```

```{r}
heat <- function(mm) {
  lr <- latest_run(mm)
  d <- pr[pr$run == lr$run, ]
  bm <- D$benchmarks[order(match(D$benchmarks$suite, SUITES), D$benchmarks$name), ]
  bm <- bm[bm$id %in% d$benchmark, ]
  cats <- CATEGORIES$category
  z <- matrix(0, nrow(bm), length(cats), dimnames = list(bm$id, cats))
  z[cbind(match(d$benchmark, bm$id), match(d$category, cats))] <- d$share
  hover <- matrix(sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %.1f%%", rep(bm$id, length(cats)),
                          rep(cats, each = nrow(bm)), 100 * as.vector(z)), nrow(bm))
  plot_ly(x = cats, y = bm$id, z = z, type = "heatmap", text = hover, hoverinfo = "text",
          colorscale = sequential_scale(), zmin = 0, zmax = 0.8, xgap = 1, ygap = 1,
          height = 15 * nrow(bm) + 130,
          colorbar = list(title = list(text = "share", font = list(color = LIGHT[["ink2"]])),
                          tickformat = ".0%", tickfont = list(color = LIGHT[["muted"]]), outlinewidth = 0,
                          len = 300, lenmode = "pixels", y = 1, yanchor = "top")) |>
    rs_layout(x = ax(NULL, type = "category", side = "top", showline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE),
              y = ax(NULL, type = "category", autorange = "reversed", showline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE,
                     tickfont = list(size = 10, color = LIGHT[["ink2"]])), legend = FALSE) |>
    layout(margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 10)) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", "Every benchmark, every category (latest release)"),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Darker: larger share. Saturates at 80%."),
  machine_tabs(D$machines$machine, heat)
)
```

## Table view

```{r}
lr <- latest_run(m)
d <- pr[pr$run == lr$run, ]
w <- stats::reshape(d[, c("benchmark", "category", "share")], idvar = "benchmark",
                    timevar = "category", direction = "wide")
names(w) <- sub("^share\\.", "", names(w))
w <- w[, c("benchmark", CATEGORIES$category)]
w$suite <- D$benchmarks$suite[match(w$benchmark, D$benchmarks$id)]
w <- w[, c("suite", "benchmark", CATEGORIES$category)]
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
cols <- lapply(CATEGORIES$category, function(c) colDef(cell = function(v) pct(v), minWidth = 72))
names(cols) <- CATEGORIES$category
p(class = "rs-muted", paste0("R ", lr$version, " · ", machine_label(m)))
rs_table(w, searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 20,
         columns = c(list(suite = colDef(minWidth = 110), benchmark = colDef(minWidth = 230,
           cell = function(v) tags$a(href = bench_url(v), v))), cols))
```

## Categories

```{r}
cat_def <- CATEGORIES
rs_table(data.frame(Category = cat_def$category, Group = cat_def$group,
                    `What it covers` = cat_def$description, check.names = FALSE),
         pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE, columns = list(`What it covers` = colDef(minWidth = 320)))
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- Each benchmark is recorded with `perf record` (DWARF call graphs, about 1000 samples per second, 5 recordings). Each sample inside `execute()` is charged to the innermost frame the [category rules](methodology.qmd#profiles) of *What Do R Benchmarks Measure?* (VMIL'26) recognise.
- Charts colour the four category groups; the ten categories are named in the heatmap and tables, because ten colours cannot be told apart reliably.
:::
